rationale: C22 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It has the same three-recital sequence, nearly identical language concerning an unadjusted Railway Labor Act dispute and the National Mediation Board's assessment, the same thirty-day reporting requirement, and the same section 10 prohibition on changing the disputed conditions. Its phrase "a large portion of the country" also appears verbatim in the child; the principal adaptations are the carrier and employee representatives. C07 and C03 employ the same reusable form but have slightly less exact factual language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pennsylvania Railroad or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Terminal Railroad Association of St. Louis or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
